description: This file defines the XmlParser class responsible for parsing XML responses according to AWS REST-XML and Query protocols. It includes methods to parse various XML shapes such as structures, lists, maps, and primitive types, using SimpleXMLElement. The class is internal and focused on converting XML data into PHP data structures as specified by AWS API models.

classes.name: XmlParser
classes.description: A class implementing XML parsing logic for AWS REST-XML and Query protocols, converting XML elements into PHP data structures based on AWS API shape definitions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Public method that initiates parsing of a structure shape from a SimpleXMLElement.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Internal method that selects the appropriate parse method based on shape type.

methods.name: parse_structure
methods.description: Parses a StructureShape from a SimpleXMLElement into an associative array.

methods.name: memberKey
methods.description: Determines the XML node name for a given shape member, considering locationName and flattening.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses a ListShape from a SimpleXMLElement into an array.

methods.name: parse_map
methods.description: Parses a MapShape from a SimpleXMLElement into an associative array.

methods.name: parse_blob
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded blob from XML content.

methods.name: parse_timestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp value from string or number into a DateTimeResult object.

methods.name: parse_xml_attribute
methods.description: Extracts an XML attribute value, considering namespace and prefix.
